layoutPolicy.variantRule: Variant directories contain only profile-specific content and overrides; shared content belongs in common.
layoutPolicy.integrationRule: Runtime integration must resolve a profile through this manifest and must not discover locomotive files by filename guessing.
layoutPolicy.idRule: Every runtime entity keeps a stable family/variant-prefixed ID namespace; profile-specific equipment must not leak into another profile.
layoutPolicy.legacyRule: Legacy package roots remain read-only migration inputs until the family manifest marks migrationState=CANONICAL_COMPLETE and family QA is green.
